item.title: Running Callander council cost nearly $141,500 in 2025
item.description: Council operations cost Callander taxpayers $141,429.45 in 2025. The lion’s share of the cost came from honorariums for the mayor and four councillors, totalling $122,561.36. Former mayor Robb Noon received $31,647.33 of which $28,486.90 was paid as an honorarium. The remaining expenses included $2,927.47 for mandatory employer benefits like CPP and $232.96 in miscellaneous expenses. […]
